name: Fast-flow vascular malformation of the central nervous system

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: CNS Fast-Flow Vascular Malformation Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of fast-flow vascular channels on cerebral angiography or MRI/MRA
Neurological symptoms attributable to vascular malformation such as seizures or focal deficits
Exclusion of other vascular malformations such as slow-flow lesions or cavernomas

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of imaging-confirmed fast-flow vascular malformation plus compatible neurological symptoms
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on advanced neuroimaging techniques including digital subtraction angiography.

searchTerms: direct artery to vein brain connections
large fast blood vessels in brain
rapid blood flow in cerebral vessels
audible blood flow sound in skull

occasional.notes: May present as sudden neurological deterioration

searchTerms: brain fluid buildup due to vein pressure
excess brain fluid caused by vein blockage
cranial nerve palsies causing facial or eye problems

rare.symptomName: Heart failure due to high-output state
searchTerms: heart failure from increased blood flow
heart strain due to excess circulation

imaging: Digital subtraction cerebral angiography showing arteriovenous shunting
MRI/MRA demonstrating fast-flow vascular channels and nidus
CT scan showing hemorrhage or calcifications
genetic: No consistent genetic mutations identified; sporadic cases predominate
other: Physical exam may reveal cranial bruits

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of high-flow arteriovenous shunting on angiography
Different clinical presentation with less hemorrhage risk
No arterial feeders or early venous drainage
Lower risk of high-output cardiac failure

redFlags: Sudden onset of severe headache with neurological deficit
New onset seizures in young adult
Signs of intracranial hemorrhage on imaging
references: Orphanet: Fast-flow vascular malformation of the central nervous system, ORPHA:715744
Al-Shahi Salman R, et al. Diagnosis and management of arteriovenous malformations of the brain. Lancet Neurol. 2019.
Meyers PM, et al. Cerebral arteriovenous malformations: clinical presentation and management. Stroke. 2018.
